rule: Allow callable Node assert candidates only when they verify machine-consumed hook commands and manifest paths, package-layout behavior, metadata-file presence, or parser structure without pinning authored prose.

allowed.rationale: Verifies that the aggregate hook manifest contains the executable ultrawork user-prompt-submit command consumed by the Codex hook runner; the assertion targets command wiring, not guidance copy.
Pins the exact executable command string read from the aggregate hook manifest, including the runtime CLI path and hook event token; it is machine-consumed configuration rather than prose.
Verifies that every ulw-loop user-prompt hook omits the legacy --with-ultrawork execution flag, protecting current hook routing behavior without inspecting prompt content.
Checks absence of the command-line flag token that selects the retired aggregate execution path; the token is parsed by the CLI and is not authored guidance.
Verifies that the aggregate manifest no longer registers the removed workflow-selection hook, an observable hook-routing invariant independent of any hook output wording.
Pins the removed hook manifest path solely as the machine-consumed registry key whose absence proves cleanup; no file contents or prose are asserted.
Verifies that aggregation ships at least one top-level SKILL.md payload through filesystem path structure; it checks package composition without reading skill prose.
Verifies that aggregation includes component-owned SKILL.md payloads at the expected package-layout boundary; only paths are inspected, not authored skill text.
Uses the /skills/ directory segment as a filesystem layout sentinel for component-owned skill payloads; it does not constrain any skill wording.
Verifies that aggregation includes the Hephaestus bundled-rule markdown files required by runtime packaging; the assertion checks path presence and never reads rule prose.
Exercises the frontmatter-envelope regular expression used while extracting a synthetic skill name; the regex defines parser structure and does not require any production prose value.
Verifies capture of the synthetic YAML frontmatter body using the parser's envelope expression; only frontmatter boundaries and capture structure are contracted.
Checks that the synthetic SKILL.md fixture yields a captured frontmatter body before field parsing; it asserts parser success rather than frontmatter prose.
Exercises the YAML name-field parser expression against synthetic frontmatter; the pattern contracts field syntax while permitting arbitrary name values.
Checks that the synthetic SKILL.md frontmatter produces a parsed name field; it requires parser output presence without pinning the field's authored value.
Verifies that aggregation materializes the component metadata file consumed by plugin discovery; this is packaged-file presence with no metadata prose assertion.
Exercises the display_name field parser expression against synthetic plugin metadata; the pattern contracts machine-readable field syntax, not the display label value.
Checks that synthetic plugin metadata yields a parsed display_name field; it requires parser output presence while allowing unrestricted label wording.
